caseNameFull: Tedesco v. Board of Supervisors of Elections for the Parish of Orleans
attorneys: George A. Dreyfous for appellant. Bolivar E. Kemp, Jr., Attorney General of Louisiana, Wm. A. Porteous, Jr., Second Assistant Attorney General, and Chas. J. Rivet for appellees.

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Court of Appeal for the Parish of Orleans, Louisiana.

Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
